annotations.title: Hand an athlete to another coach

description: Hand an athlete to another coach, as the profile's "Hand to another coach" card does: makes a link to send that coach; when they accept it, the athlete moves to their roster with all their history. Nothing moves until then. withdraw: true cancels a link already sent.

athlete_id.description: May be omitted when you coach exactly one athlete.

name: hand_off_athlete
